input.scope: input delivery only; native Cua and owned state readback must prove actual gesture/render

gesture.frame_render_time_label_scope: Single native UI label only; not mouse-to-display latency, not a repeated timing distribution or baseline comparison
gesture.pixel_equality_scope: Visual functional restoration only; byte-exact exported quality evidence is in other host records

authorization.standard_cgevent: Human explicitly authorized input only in owned AE test.
authorization.accessibility: Human separately approved each of the two local helpers at action time; normal System Settings UI/authentication used.
authorization.initial_approval_rejection: Initial Open rejected by automatic approval review; new explicit action-time confirmation obtained before access change.
scope_checks: AX trust required; no automatic prompt, TCC database mutation or bypass.
Exact AE executable/PID and foreground checked at each step.
Routed gesture confined to test composition bounds and80-point maximum displacement.
authorization.grants_lifecycle: Two explicitly authorized helper grants retained for remaining owned AE checks; no broader grant.

excluded_attempts: Absent Accessibility or wrong foreground: refused before input.
Addressed postToPid delivery did not confirm an actual guide edit; excluded.
Literal grave key was rejected; separate grave input changed owned layer timing and was immediately undone/read back; excluded from measurements.

lifecycle.fast_preview_restoration: Guarded cleanup restores previous Fast Preview and checks the readback before closing.

limits: No observer-free first-frame or guide-to-display timing.
One gesture only; no baseline guide comparison or repeated input distribution.
